title: CALCULATE with a calendar's DATESBETWEEN keeps the filter on a column no calendar tags
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "ltd", CALCULATE ( [Total], DATESBETWEEN ( Gregorian, BLANK (), MAX ( 'Date'[Date] ) ) ) ), 'Date'[DayOfWeek] = "Sun", 'Date'[YearMonth] = 200808 )

source.quote: With a calendar, CALCULATE removes only the filters on the columns of the calendar. The filters on the other columns of the date table stay, for example a filter on the day of the week.
source.supports: the rule; the page's Sales LTD Calendar example sums only Sundays

derivation: MAX ( Date[Date] ) of the Sundays of August 2008 is August 31. DATESBETWEEN gives July 27 to August 31; the filter on YearMonth (tagged) is removed, the one on DayOfWeek (untagged) stays: the Sundays July 27, August 3, 10, 17, 24, 31: 27 + 3 + 10 + 17 + 24 + 31 = 112.
